title: Partition Function
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the partition function Z = (e^(mu_0 B / kT) + e^(-mu_0 B / kT))^N.

title: Specific Heat
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the specific heat c = kN (mu_0 B / kT)^2 / cosh^2(mu_0 B / kT).

title: Average Magnetic Moment
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the thermal average magnetic moment as M = Nmu_0 tanh(mu_0 B / kT).

title: Curie Law Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show that chi = dM/dB = (Nmu_0^2 / kT) / cosh^2(mu_0 B / kT) satisfies the Curie Law in the high temperature limit.

title: High Temperature Limit
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention that in the high temperature limit, chi is proportional to 1/T.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the expressions for energy and specific heat.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
